root_cause.text: fmt_src and fmt_dst were freed under inst->lock while the instance remained in the core list, allowing a concurrent MBPF checker walking the core list under core->lock to access freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that the MBPF checker iterates the core list under core->lock and reads fmt_src fields, while iris_close() frees fmt_src and fmt_dst under inst->lock without removing the instance from the core list. The patch moves the kfree calls from the per-instance deinit functions (called under inst->lock) to after the instance is removed from the core list in iris_close().
